Laurey 52020, Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull in Matte Black

The Matte Black Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull is ideal for traditional kitchens. The Matte Black finish is all at once modern and classic. This Nantucket Cabinet Cup Pull in Matte Black comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet cup pull is part of the Laurey Nantucket Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 52020 3 Inch Pull Nantucket Matte Black:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 1-3/4"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
